items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: In fact, he wrote one of the tunes that Earl Coleman recorded when he recorded with Erroll Garner and Charlie Parker on that Dial date...

ctx.x: And lots of places... I will never forget. I had moved over to Howard McGhee's house after we lived together down on Vernon. And that was during the time when he first made the Dial dates, the dates for Dial Records with Roy Porter and Vic McMillan and Howard McGhee and...no, I think Miles was on the first set, that's right, and Lucky Thompson. I think we made "Ornithology" and "Yardbird Suite" and "Moose The Mooche" and those things. In fact, the day he wrote "Moose The Mooche," he came over and sang it to me.

But anyway, we used to play at different places. But I never will forget one setting, one Saturday. There was a bass player around here named Shifty Henry. In fact, he wrote one of the tunes that Earl Coleman recorded when he recorded with Erroll Garner and Charlie Parker on that Dial date...
